grain: one NCHS live-birth record for a U.S. resident

population.reason: Aligns the prepared denominator with the national resident-birth population reported in the source specification.

split.warning: The public-use file has no stable maternal identifier, so pregnancies of the same woman cannot be grouped across births.

predictor_policy: Use only demographic, pre-pregnancy and prior-history fields that plausibly precede the current pregnancy outcome.

labels.target_low_birthweight_2500g: DBWT < 2500 g; explicitly not an SGA or FGR label

excluded_predictors: total prenatal visits when claiming an early-pregnancy prediction
claim_limits: HDP is a heterogeneous proxy and is not an early preeclampsia diagnosis.
The GDM field has no diagnosis timestamp and does not validate first-trimester screening.
PTB phenotype cannot always be separated reliably into spontaneous and indicated births.
Low birth weight is not SGA and is not fetal growth restriction.
Results require external and local validation before any clinical interpretation.

hdp_proxy_study.cohort: U.S. resident singleton live births, 2023+2024, known RF_GHYPE and RF_EHYPE, RF_PHYPE=0
hdp_proxy_study.primary_outcome: RF_GHYPE=Y OR RF_EHYPE=Y; recorded HDP proxy, not a separate preeclampsia diagnosis
secondary_outcomes: primary outcome AND OEGEST_COMB<37, unknown if gestation unknown
primary outcome AND OEGEST_COMB<34, unknown if gestation unknown
hdp_proxy_study.pooled_cross_validation: stable 5 folds over all eligible 2023 and 2024 births, one OOF prediction per record
hdp_proxy_study.temporal_validation: 5-fold development within 2023, then frozen 2023 fit and full 2024 retrospective test
hdp_proxy_study.rule_limitation: observable subset of USPSTF factors; missing clinical factors prevent a full recommendation
hdp_proxy_study.source_reporting: 2024 ART/infertility fields must honor F_RF_INFT and F_RF_INF_ART flags; ILLB_R 888 differs from 999
